findings.evidence: Fixer model: `sonnet` on Claude Code (Haiku misses subtle defects; Opus burns tokens for no extra fix-quality signal).
findings.fix: Move the sonnet-versus-Haiku-versus-Opus cost claim to references/cli-profiles/claude.md, dated against the host's model list, and keep only the rule that Claude Code runs the fixer as sonnet and every other host uses the session default.

findings.evidence: ## NEVER (hard landmines) lists only two rules and points to the later Hard rules table.
findings.fix: Keep one NEVER section that includes every hard rule with its reason, including wrong-worktree grounding and never switching a failed lane, instead of splitting two of them off from the table.

findings.evidence: Description covers review-and-fix, frameworks, and --cross-ai, but not the no-config stop and the review-only ask-before-edit cases.
findings.fix: Use when a design, spec, requirements, or plan document needs review-and-fix before the next step. Framework-aware across superpowers, GSD, OpenSpec, Spec Kit, Kiro, BMAD, and generic docs: orchestrates a clean-context reviewer and routes fixes through the framework skill, slash command, or direct-edit fixer, including --cross-ai and --no-cross-ai. Also use when the user names one of those frameworks with a spec, plan, or design review, passes document paths, or says review my spec or plan. A review-only request asks before any rewrite. With no cross-AI config it asks once and can stop. Not for writing a new spec, executing a plan, scoring a SKILL.md, or configuring the reviewer roster.

findings.evidence: MANDATORY — READ ENTIRE FILE, on every run of references/cross-ai-dispatch.md, including under --no-cross-ai.
findings.fix: Keep the every-run read for the path, temp-dir, and session-default points, and gate the ladder, quota, and pending-lane sections on a subprocess or cross-AI route so --no-cross-ai does not load them.

findings.evidence: a cached profile for a known-to-drift framework (`bmad`, `gsd`) older than ~180 days is a refresh candidate — you may re-research
findings.fix: Make refresh the default when a bmad or gsd cache is older than 180 days, with skip only when the user says to keep the cached profile.

findings.evidence: 20 queries, 10 should-trigger and 10 should-not, but no train/validation split and no recorded trigger-rate runs.
findings.fix: Split the 20 queries into a fixed train and validation set, each mixing positives and near-miss negatives, and record trigger rates from repeated runs beside the file.

findings.evidence: ArgumentParser(prog="review-spec") while the shipped entry point is ai-kit-spec.py.
findings.fix: Set prog to ai-kit-spec so --help usage matches the command the skill tells the agent to run.

findings.evidence: last_verified: 2026-08-28 for claude -p --model <model> --output-format json --permission-mode plan, and the same date on codex, cursor, and grok profiles.
findings.fix: Re-run each CLI's --help or smoke test and update last_verified and the formula, or mark the formula as read live from the runner's --describe instead of a dated argv.
